purpose: Test whether coordinate-selective, bounded application of the already selected yaw-harmonic correction improves held-session PnP measurements without using the scored outer fold for postprocessor selection.
outer_split: the existing five deterministic session-hash folds
inner_split: for each outer fold, generate predictions for each of the other four folds from a model fitted on the remaining three folds

selection.eligibility: inner out-of-fold P50, P90 and P95 cross-depth error must not exceed raw PnP and 55 mm coverage must exceed raw PnP
selection.ranking: lexicographically maximize 55 mm coverage, then minimize P90, P50 and P95; final ties prefer fewer corrected coordinates, smaller blend and smaller finite cap
selection.outer_evaluation: apply the selected outer-fold-specific postprocessor to the original outer-fold yaw-harmonic prediction

promotion: Promote only if aggregate outer-held 55 mm coverage strictly exceeds the unprocessed yaw-harmonic correction and P50, P90 and P95 are all no worse.
truth_policy: Truth is used to select the postprocessor only inside outer-training folds and to score the held outer fold; it is never a runtime feature.
